notes: The site was located from the dock, which lies about 150 m north of the published coordinates. Zoom 19 tiles are placeholders here, so the current zoom 18 mosaic (Vantor Vivid 2026-02-27, 0.55 m/px) is used for every point. Wayback releases 8432, 16749, 47471, 64776, 32553 and 52304 were viewed (47471 shows the dock dry) but are blurrier or shifted by 3-4 m against the current mosaic, so they were not used. Plan corners come from straight lines fitted to the outline pixels of each drawn side; imagery corners from lines fitted to the wall-top lines of the dock and the podium. The plan carries a compass rose; I did not read or use it.
